title: Big Order
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ten years ago a being called Daisy granted wishes as 'Orders', and the child Eiji Hoshimiya's wish caused the 'Great Destruction' that wrecked much of the world. Now a guilt-ridden high schooler, Eiji is pulled into a world-domination plot by other Order users, while his terminally ill stepsister Iyo's life hangs in the balance. A supernatural action series about wishes, power and guilt.
life_message: Power gained by wishing carries a terrible cost, and devotion to family pushes Eiji to act.
